name: Hinterlander
biography: This vagabond once chose to live outside of civilization, deep in the wilds where no one could tell him what to do, or so he thought until he was thrown into Brüttelburg’s Undercity Dungeon for shooting some wealthy bastard’s stag.

Accustomed to sleeping outdoors & fending for himself, the Hinterlander is tough as nails but uncomfortable when interacting with his fellow man. An ever-vigilant survivor, he has a strong tendency towards paranoia & superstition along with an utter disdain for the tedious laws & customs of civilized society.
